_comment: Ratchet baseline for `npm run lint`. CI fails if the error count rises above this.
It may only ever be lowered. When it reaches 0, replace the ratchet step in
.github/workflows/ci.yml with a plain `npm run lint` and delete this file.
These are not arbitrary style debt. The dominant rules map directly to filed bugs:
react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -> the state-race and stale-response defects (#91)
react-hooks/immutability,        -> React Compiler correctness rules; this
purity, preserve-manual-memo       project has the compiler in devDependencies
So burning this number down is the same work as closing the frontend issues.
86 -> 84: the P1 frontend fixes (chat reveal stopped rewriting the message array).
84 -> 78: issue #94 deleted ~1,100 LOC of unreferenced components, which carried
six of these errors with them.
